method: Finely chop the tomatoes and coriander (stalks and all) and place into a large bowl.
Peel and finely chop the onion, de-seed and finely chop the chillies, then scrape into the bowl. Peel and finely grate in the garlic.
Squeeze in the juice from 1 lime, add 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil, and mix well. Season to taste with sea salt, black pepper and more lime juice, if needed.
